purpose: Validate that the property fixture governance audit log is append-only, traceable, chronologically coherent and separated from legal evidence and publication status.

checks.name: Event identity
checks.requirement: Every recorded event has a unique event ID and recorded date.

checks.name: Traceability
checks.requirement: Events reference the relevant fixture, impact event, queue item, validation run or source contract where applicable.

checks.name: Chronological coherence
checks.requirement: The recorded sequence reflects the governance progression without silently reversing state.

checks.name: Append-only protection
checks.requirement: Historical audit entries are retained rather than overwritten by later status changes.

checks.name: Historical immutability
checks.requirement: Audit history cannot be used to rewrite historical validation results.

checks.name: Legal evidence separation
checks.requirement: Audit events are not treated as proof of ownership, title or other property facts.

checks.name: Publication separation
checks.requirement: Audit-log success cannot independently make a pathway publication-ready.

guardrails: It does not verify Irish property law.
It does not represent live official-record retrieval.
It does not upgrade any property pathway to publication-ready.
